rootCause.summary: The payment attempt for TX9003 timed out waiting for an upstream payment provider (payment service recorded an UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT with HTTP 504), and that timeout propagated to the checkout service, causing the checkout to fail. Provider-side details (gateway logs/audit) are not present in the available database/audit sources, so the exact reason for the upstream timeout (provider outage, network, or gateway rejection) cannot be determined from the collected evidence.
limitations: No provider/gateway logs or database audit rows were returned for this attempt (database query returned no matching records). Missing upstream provider details prevents definitive identification of the root cause of the 504 timeout.

A 504/UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT is a symptom; available records show the timeout occurred but do not show whether the provider returned an error, dropped the request, or whether a network/relay issue caused the timeout.
Clock/timestamp ordering is used only for display chronology; causal assertions are based on explicit causedByEventId links in the records but deeper infrastructure traces are absent.

failureFlow.event: payment.timeout — Upstream payment request timed out (errorCode=UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT, httpStatus=504).

recommendation.action: Request upstream provider/gateway logs for the timeframe around 2026-09-14T10:00:00Z for attempt PA1 (correlate on transaction or provider request id if available).
recommendation.reason: The payment service recorded an UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT (httpStatus=504) but provider-side logs are missing from the collected data; those logs are required to determine whether the provider rejected the request, experienced an outage, or there was a network relay issue.

recommendation.action: Check payment gateway audit/database for any recorded transaction/posting for PA1 and reconcile with customer billing.
recommendation.reason: To ensure the customer was not charged despite the timeout and to enable correct remediation (refund or confirmation) if a provider later processed the charge.

recommendation.action: Instrument/add retention of provider response details and gateway request IDs into the payment audit table (or ensure they are persisted) so future timeouts include provider correlation information.
recommendation.reason: Recorded evidence shows 'provider details absent' in the payment.timeout record; persisting provider response/IDs will allow definitive root-cause identification for upstream timeouts.

recommendation.action: If this customer experienced a visible failure, notify them with clear guidance (e.g., payment may not have completed; we are investigating) and avoid automatic financial retries without idempotency guarantees.
recommendation.reason: The checkout failed after a payment timeout; retries without idempotency or confirmation from provider could risk duplicate charges.
